description: Adversarial fixture for Phase D1 handler resolution. Two modules each define `list_users`; only the `server` module's version is the real handler registered on the axum router. The HTTP_CALLS edge from `client::call_users` MUST resolve to `server::list_users`, NOT `decoy::list_users`.
notes: The decoy module's list_users shares the bare-name with the real handler. Pre-D1 the resolution either picked the route-declaring function (build_router) or arbitrarily picked one of the two list_users via FindNodesByName. Post-D1 crate-locality wins: server::list_users shares more QN-prefix with server::routes::build_router than decoy::list_users does, so it gets selected. forbidden_to_qn_suffixes pin the assertion that the wrong handler does NOT appear as the edge target.
